description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 10.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," is also a linear scale ranging from 18 to 28, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot contains four distinct lines, each representing a model. The "Consistency-CE" model is represented by a light purple line with circular markers. It starts at a BLEU score of approximately 19.0 at an AL of 0.0 and increases to about 27.0 at an AL of 10.0. The "Inconsistency-CE" model is shown as a dark purple line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 20.0 at an AL of 0.0 and rising to about 27.2 at an AL of 10.0. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" model is depicted by a dark blue line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 18.5 at an AL of 0.0 and increasing to about 27.2 at an AL of 10.0. The "Consistency-Bi" model is represented by a red line with star markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 22.5 at an AL of 0.0 and increasing to a peak of about 28.5 at an AL of 8.0, before slightly decreasing to approximately 28.3 at an AL of 10.0. All lines show an overall increasing trend in BLEU score as average lagging increases.
